name: Hub75 → Set Brightness
description: This action allows you to dynamically change the brightness of the display at runtime.

config_entries.label: Brightness
config_entries.description: The brightness level to set (0-255). A value of 0 effectively turns off the display, while 255 is maximum brightness.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the HUB75 display component. Only required if you have multiple `hub75` platform displays configured.
